create_user: create a new user by calling create_user on UsersManagementClient with user data dictionary
list_users: list all users by calling list_users on UsersManagementClient with optional query params
get_user: get user info by calling get_user on UsersManagementClient with an optional user_id
get_user_v2: get lightweight user info by calling get_user_v2 on UsersManagementClient with an optional user_id
delete_user: delete users by calling delete_user on UsersManagementClient with a list of user ids
